subject: Math
subskill: Predict Value Using Line of Best Fit
prompt:
[Figure 1]

The scatterplot shows the heights, in feet, of $7$ young oak trees with respect to their ages, in years. The line of best fit is also shown. A researcher measures a young oak tree that is $6$ years old. According to the line of best fit, which of the following best approximates the height of the tree, in feet?
explanation: Choice B is correct. According to the line of best fit, a tree with an age of $6$ years has a predicted height between $22$ feet and $24$ feet. The only choice in this range is $23$.
